title: Pulsar Sentinel
text: Post-quantum cryptography shouldn't require a PhD. Pulsar Sentinel brings ML-KEM-768 security to everyone — starting at $10.99/mo. Built on Polygon. Running on Pi. Because privacy before convenience.

title: Thought Tree
text: Your brain doesn't think in lists. It thinks in trees. Thought Tree is a visual mind-mapping app built for the way ideas actually work — branching, connecting, cascading. Dark theme. Orange accents. Built with React.

title: The Infrastructure
text: Raspberry Pi 5. 16GB RAM. Pironman 5-MAX chassis. 2TB NVMe RAID 1. 17 Weaviate collections. 27 MCP tools. Zero cloud bills. If you don't own your infrastructure, you don't own your future.

title: The Mission
text: Put real AI tools in the hands of the ~800 million people Big Tech is about to leave behind. That's the mission. Everything else is a tactic.

title: Local-First AI
text: Pi before cloud. Privacy before convenience. Every project in the ShaneBrain ecosystem runs on local hardware. Because the moment you depend on someone else's server, you're renting your own future.
